main.description: Look up a `network.attested.payment` record by uri. Returns a `#view`: status, broker, timestamps, and signatures are always present; private fields (`subject`, `items`, `total`, `currency`) are auto-filled by the broker only when the caller is one of the signing parties.

view.description: Hydrated view of a `network.attested.payment` record. Shape mirrors the `network.attested.payment.initiate` input plus `total`, the record's uri/cid, and signatures. Private fields (`subject`, `items`, `total`, `currency`) are auto-filled by the broker only when the caller is one of the signing parties; for other callers, the view degrades to the record's public surface.

subject.description: DID of the payment recipient. Auto-filled when the caller is authorized; absent otherwise.

items.description: Line items as supplied to `initiate`. Auto-filled when the caller is authorized; absent otherwise.

total.description: Sum of line item amounts in the smallest currency unit. Auto-filled when the caller is authorized; absent otherwise.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of `total`. Auto-filled when the caller is authorized; absent otherwise.
